ALWAYS use this skill when: - The user says "deploy agents", "spin up a team", "parallelize this", "swarm this issue" - An issue or feature involves 2+ distinct sub-components (e.g. Worker + DO + types + tests) - A task is too large for one Claude Code session to hold in context cleanly - The user provides a GitLab issue number and asks to start work - The user wants to implement multiple features in parallel - Any multi-part implementation task where file boundaries can be drawn
